messages.content:
Create a modern, professional, clean, and fully responsive sample website suitable for an internship program project.
Website Requirements:
Overall Design
Make the website look formal, elegant, and professional.
Use a minimal and modern UI with a clean layout.
Choose a professional colour palette such as navy blue, white, light grey, and subtle blue accents.
Use readable fonts, proper spacing, consistent alignment, and subtle animations.
Avoid excessive colours, flashy effects, or unnecessary design elements.
Homepage
Create a professional navigation bar with a logo and menu options.
Include a welcoming hero section with a clear heading, short description, and a Call-to-Action button.
Add a professional background or subtle visual elements.
Include an introduction about the organization or project.
About Section
Explain the purpose of the website.
Include the organization's mission, vision, and objectives.
Use a structured and easy-to-read layout.
Services / Features Section
Display key services or features using clean cards.
Include simple icons and short descriptions.
Maintain consistent spacing and styling.
Projects / Work Section
Add a section to showcase sample projects or completed work.
Use professional cards with project titles, descriptions, and relevant images.
Contact Section
Include a contact form with Name, Email, Subject, and Message fields.
Add contact information and social media links.
Include basic form validation.
Footer
Add copyright information, quick navigation links, and contact details.
Technical Requirements:
Use HTML, CSS, and JavaScript or a suitable modern framework.
Make the website fully responsive on mobile phones, tablets, and desktops.
Ensure all navigation links and buttons work correctly.
Use semantic HTML and accessible design practices.
Maintain good colour contrast and readable font sizes.
Add proper labels to form fields.
Include hover effects and subtle transitions.
Optimize images and website loading performance.
Keep the code clean, organized, and easy to understand.
Important Instructions:
Do not create a basic or outdated-looking website.
Make it look like a genuine professional organization's website.
Use realistic sample content instead of lorem ipsum.
Ensure the website is complete and functional, not just a visual mockup.
Prioritize accessibility, usability, simplicity, and professional presentation.
Before finishing, test the website for responsiveness, broken links, and basic functionality.
The final result should look polished and suitable for presenting as a sample project during an internship evaluation.

I have created a modern, professional, clean, and fully responsive website designed specifically for an internship evaluation: **Nexis Global Technologies — Emerging Talent & Engineering Fellowship**.

You can view the live site here:
**[View Live Website Preview](https://antigravity.luch.dev/site/596eac75-0ba4-4a79-9362-88d4e1569bbc/2e6c8bf6f3fee97a0f338902/)**

---

### Project Architecture & Design Highlights

1. **Executive Visual Design & Palette**:
   - **Color Palette**: Deep corporate navy (`#060b17`, `#0a1128`, `#0f172a`), slate grey structural borders (`#e2e8f0`), electric blue accents (`#2563eb`, `#0284c7`, `#38bdf8`), and emerald indicators (`#10b981`).
   - **Typography**: Clean hierarchy using [Plus Jakarta Sans](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Plus+Jakarta+Sans) for editorial clarity and [JetBrains Mono](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/JetBrains+Mono) for technical benchmarks and code badges.
   - **Theme System**: Integrated Dark/Light mode toggle with persistence in `localStorage` and system theme detection.

2. **Homepage & Welcoming Hero**:
   - Fixed navigation bar with SVG brand mark, active scroll spy highlighting, mobile drawer toggle, theme switch, and quick CTA.
   - Welcoming Hero section with cohort badge, authoritative headline, value proposition, and primary/secondary CTAs.
   - Dynamic key metrics counter (98.4% placement rate, 45+ capstones shipped, 1:3 mentor ratio, 18 global partner labs).

3. **About Section**:
   - Transparent overview explaining the purpose of the fellowship.
   - Clear cards detailing the organization's **Mission**, **Vision**, and **Strategic Objectives**.
   - **12-Week Milestone Timeline** detailing the 4 progression phases from onboarding to Executive Demo Day.

4. **Specialized Fellowship Tracks (Services)**:
   - 6 specialized engineering tracks: *Cloud & Distributed Systems*, *Applied AI & ML Systems*, *Enterprise Full-Stack Platforms*, *Cybersecurity & Zero-Trust Architecture*, *Data Engineering & Real-Time Analytics*, and *Systems Software & Low-Latency HPC*.
   - Interactive modal triggers on each track card to inspect week-by-week immersion syllabi and candidate prerequisites.

5. **Sample Capstone Projects Showcase**:
   - 6 realistic sample production projects completed by intern cohorts (*MediScan AI*, *Apex CloudScale*, *SentinelZero*, *EcoMetric Grid*, *FinStream Core*, and *OmniCollab Workspace*).
   - High-fidelity vector SVG technical diagrams and architecture illustrations for every card.
   - Category filter pills (*All*, *AI & Vision*, *Cloud & Systems*, *Zero-Trust*, *Web Platforms & IoT*) and live real-time keyword search.
   - Interactive **"Explore Case Study"** modal displaying performance benchmarks, system architecture details, tech stack badges, and fellow/mentor credits.

6. **Mentorship & Alumni Spotlights**:
   - Profiles of Principal & Staff mentors from leading technology labs.
   - Verifiable alumni quote cards highlighting career transitions to companies like OpenAI, Cloudflare, Datadog, and Stripe.

7. **Interactive Application & Contact Section**:
   - Dual-column layout featuring office location, admissions email, review cycle hours, and social media channels (LinkedIn, GitHub, X, Discord).
   - Interactive admissions FAQ accordion with animated expand/collapse.
   - Full application and inquiry form with real-time field validation (Name, Email format, Track, Subject, Message character count, and Agreement checkbox), async submission state simulation, and instant success confirmation with unique reference IDs.

8. **Footer**:
   - Semantic footer with organization overview, categorized sitemap links, live technical dispatch newsletter subscription, copyright notice, and legal/privacy statement modals.

---

### Code Structure
```
workspace/
├── index.html                 # Semantic HTML5 with accessible ARIA landmarks & labels
├── css/
│   └── style.css              # Custom properties, responsive grid/flexbox, animations & dark mode
├── js/
│   └── main.js                # Vanilla ES6 module: navigation, counters, modals, filters & validation
└── assets/
    ├── favicon.svg            # Custom SVG monogram favicon
    └── images/                # High-resolution architectural SVG project illustrations
        ├── project-1.svg      # MediScan AI diagnostic telemetry
        ├── project-2.svg      # Apex CloudScale multi-region cluster
        ├── project-3.svg      # SentinelZero zero-trust enclave mesh
        ├── project-4.svg      # EcoMetric Grid IoT telematics engine
        ├── project-5.svg      # FinStream Core distributed order matching
        └── project-6.svg      # OmniCollab CRDT collaborative canvas
```
